description: Aménagements intégrant la gestion durable et intégrée des eaux pluviales en Mayenne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Le Conseil Départemental de la Mayenne. La Gestion Durable et Intégrée des Eaux Pluviales (GDIEP) est un ensemble de solutions permettant d’infiltrer la goutte d’eau au plus près d’où elle tombe afin de rétablir le cycle naturel de l’eau. Coverage: Le Conseil Départemental de la Mayenne. The publisher named on the listing is Le Conseil Départemental de la Mayenne. Its keywords include territoire, observatoire, eaux-pluviales, gdiep, urbanisme-logement, environnement. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML+XML, OCTET-STREAM, N3, SHEET. The listing shows 2026-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
